title: predication-cell-set
description: The set Phi := E x Pi x E, the Cartesian product of an entity set, a predicate set, and the entity set; its elements are the predication cells at which predication valuations assign values.

entitySet.description: the entity set E, supplying both the subject and object factors

predicateSet.description: the predicate set Pi, the middle factor

elements.description: the predication cells of Phi = E x Pi x E, each an ordered triple (subject, predicate, object)

cartesianProduct.description: Phi = E x Pi x E: every element is a triple of an entity, a predicate, and an entity
